subject: Checking on the ladder sale
text: I wanted to follow up about the step ladder you listed last month. I still think the price was fair, and I'm comfortable coming with my own van, so the transport problem on your side shouldn't be a blocker. My main issue is timing. I was hoping to take it this weekend, but my schedule has shifted and I may not be free until early next week. I'm sorry for the inconvenience, especially if you've already started making room in the garage. If you'd rather sell it to someone else by then, I completely understand. You've already been helpful, and I don't want to hold you up. A possible alternative could work too: my cousin is visiting on Thursday afternoon and could inspect it then, and if it matches what you described, he can take it off your hands while I sort my own calendar. I'd still pay the same amount, and we could make the exchange simple, maybe on your front porch or near the side path. Just let me know whether Thursday is convenient, whether you prefer another evening, or whether the ladder is already spoken for. Either way, I appreciate you answering my earlier questions about the loose hinge and the top rail. Please don't worry if you have to move on; a clear answer now would still be useful so I can plan accordingly. I can also send the payment through the same bank transfer method we discussed, or I can bring cash if that feels simpler for you. Let me know whichever feels safer.
